es: Resolver una situación de intercambio: contar lo ocurrido, deducir causas, transmitir mensajes y acordar una solución.

teaching.en: There was a misunderstanding: the host family had not received our message.
teaching.es: Hubo un malentendido: la familia anfitriona no había recibido nuestro mensaje.
teaching.explanationEs: Relato con antecedente: pasado simple + had + participio.
segments: There was a misunderstanding: the host
family had not received our message.
teaching.audioText: There was a misunderstanding: the host family had not received our message.

teaching.en: The cause must have been the wrong address, because the message came back.
teaching.es: La causa debió de ser la dirección equivocada, porque el mensaje volvió.
teaching.explanationEs: Must have + participio: deducción respaldada por una prueba.
segments: The cause must have been the wrong
address, because the message came back.
teaching.audioText: The cause must have been the wrong address, because the message came back.

teaching.en: The teacher made a promise: she said that she would call the family.
teaching.es: La profesora hizo una promesa: dijo que llamaría a la familia.
teaching.explanationEs: Discurso indirecto: will pasa a would.
segments: The teacher made a promise: she said
that she would call the family.
teaching.audioText: The teacher made a promise: she said that she would call the family.

teaching.en: We apologise for the problem; if we had checked the address, we would have avoided it.
teaching.es: Pedimos disculpas por el problema; si hubiéramos comprobado la dirección, lo habríamos evitado.
teaching.explanationEs: Tercer condicional: if + had + participio, would have + participio.
segments: We apologise for the problem; if we had
checked the address, we would have avoided it.
teaching.audioText: We apologise for the problem; if we had checked the address, we would have avoided it.

teaching.en: I suggest a simple plan: a new message today, and a call tomorrow.
teaching.es: Sugiero un plan sencillo: un mensaje nuevo hoy y una llamada mañana.
teaching.explanationEs: Suggest + algo: una propuesta para acordar la solución.
segments: I suggest a simple plan: a new
message today, and a call tomorrow.
teaching.audioText: I suggest a simple plan: a new message today, and a call tomorrow.

teaching.en: Do we have a deal? Yes, we have a deal.
teaching.es: ¿Tenemos un trato? Sí, tenemos un trato.
teaching.explanationEs: Do we have a deal? cierra el acuerdo.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase cuenta lo ocurrido con un antecedente?

choices.text: The family has not received our message when we arrived.
The family had not received our message before we arrived.
The family would not receive our message before we arrived.

feedback.es: El antecedente se forma con had + participio: la familia no había recibido el mensaje antes de que llegáramos.

hint.es: Hecho anterior a otro pasado: had + participio.

prompt.es: Completa: «Prometió que llamaría a la familia.»

feedback.es: En discurso indirecto, el futuro will retrocede a would: promised that she would call.

hint.es: El futuro de la promesa retrocede un paso.

feedback.es: Suggest that + sujeto + verbo base presenta la propuesta.

hint.es: Empieza con el verbo que propone.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué propone Ana.

feedback.es: Ana sugiere tomar el autobús. Esperar el tren o volver en coche no se mencionan.

origin.audio: Tom: The train did not come. Ana: That must have been because of the storm. I suggest that we take the bus.

prompt.es: Carlos dijo: «I will call at four.» ¿Cómo lo cuenta Mia después?

choices.text: Carlos said that he would call at four.
Carlos told that he would call at four.
Carlos said me that he would call at four.

feedback.es: Said that + oración, con will convertido en would. Told y said me necesitan otra construcción: told me that…

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase del texto es una deducción?

choices.text: The bag must have gone to another airport.

feedback.es: Must have gone es una deducción basada en una prueba. El aterrizaje es un hecho y «not careful» es una opinión.

origin.text: The plane landed at six. The bag must have gone to another airport. In my opinion, the airline was not careful.

prompt.es: Completa las tres frases con la forma adecuada.

feedback.es: Pasiva con was sent, relativa con who y petición educada con Could: tres puntos para revisar antes de escribir.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué dice Tom sobre la llamada.

choices.text: He is sure that the call came at four.
He says that the call never happened.
It is possible that the call came earlier.

feedback.es: Tom usa might have called: una posibilidad, no una certeza. La certeza es de Sara y lo no confirmado, de Leo.

origin.audio: Sara: I am sure the family called at four. Tom: I think they might have called earlier. Leo: Apparently, nobody answered, but nobody has confirmed it.

prompt.es: Escribe tu mensaje final: relato, deducción, mensaje transmitido y acuerdo.

answer.text: There was a misunderstanding at the airport. The host family had not received our message, so nobody met me. The address must have been wrong, because the message came back. The school told me that they would send a new message. If they had checked the address, they would have avoided the problem. I suggest that we call the family today. Do we have a deal?
accepted: There was a misunderstanding at the airport. The host family had not received our message, so nobody met me. The address must have been wrong, because the message came back. The school told me that they would send a new message. If they had checked the address, they would have avoided the problem. I suggest that we call the family today. Do we have a deal?

There was a misunderstanding at the airport. The host family hadn't received our message, so nobody met me. The address must have been wrong, because the message came back. The school told me that they would send a new message. If the school had checked the address, they would have avoided the problem. I suggest that we phone the family today. Do we have a deal?

There was a misunderstanding at the airport. The family had not received our message, so nobody met me. The address must have been wrong, because the message came back. The school said that they would send a new message. If they had checked the address, they would have avoided the problem. I suggest that we call the family today. Do we have a deal?

feedback.es: El mensaje final junta el relato con antecedente (had not received), la causa deducida (must have been), el mensaje transmitido (told me that… would), la hipótesis (would have avoided) y la propuesta con cierre (I suggest… Do we have a deal?).

origin.text: Datos: cuéntale a tu coordinador lo que pasó: la familia anfitriona no había recibido el mensaje, así que nadie te recibió en el aeropuerto. Deduce la causa: la dirección debió de estar equivocada, porque el mensaje volvió. Transmite lo que te dijo la escuela: que enviaría un mensaje nuevo. Hipótesis: si hubieran comprobado la dirección, habrían evitado el problema. Sugiere llamar hoy a la familia y cierra el acuerdo.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase expresa una deducción con cautela?

choices.text: The message might have gone to the wrong address.
The message definitely went to the wrong address.
The message will go to the wrong address.

feedback.es: Might have gone expresa una posibilidad sobre el pasado con cautela. Definitely es certeza total y will habla del futuro.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Le pedimos disculpas por el malentendido.»

feedback.es: Apologise for + lo que causó el problema: for the misunderstanding.
Un deal es un trato o acuerdo; Do we have a deal? sirve para cerrar una negociación.
